info.title: Investment Simulator API
info.description: Deterministic comparisons of a taxable brokerage account and OKI for one accumulating global equity exposure. All money and source quantities use decimal JSON strings. Rates are decimal fractions (0.0085 = 0.85%). Future returns, inflation and OKI rates are supplied explicitly. No OKI asset allowance is applied. Bodies are limited to 2097152 bytes. The default listener is 127.0.0.1:8080.

get.summary: Check that the process is running

post.summary: Compare strategies against one baseline on the same deterministic market path
post.description: Compare strategies against one baseline on the same deterministic market path

400.description: Invalid JSON, input or unsupported portfolio data

413.description: Request exceeds the body size limit

post.summary: Compare a deterministic grid of additive rate shifts and shorter horizons
post.description: Each axis supports at most 16 values. The grid supports at most 128 scenarios and 2000000 total simulated strategy-days. Opening tax-lot replays across scenarios and strategies are limited to 250000. Rate shifts are additive decimal fractions (0.01 = one percentage point); established OKI rates remain unchanged. Each horizon must end on 31 December and cannot extend beyond the base request. The entire grid is validated before simulation. Results group strategy summaries by horizon.

200.description: Complete grid; scenario frequencies are not probabilities and transitions bracket adjacent samples only

400.description: Invalid JSON, invalid scenario, or exceeded grid limit; no partial result is returned

413.description: Request exceeds the body size limit
